# Animal Protective Foundation

> Animal Protective Foundation is a comprehensive animal shelter and wellness organization serving the Capital Region, offering adoption services, veterinary care, community outreach, and pet reunification programs.

Based in Glenville, New York, the Animal Protective Foundation provides adoption services for dogs, cats, and small animals, along with affordable spay/neuter clinics, pet training, and community wellness programs. The organization operates through volunteer support and donor contributions to advance animal welfare in the region.

## Key Topics

- Pet adoption
- Animal shelter services
- Spay and neuter clinic
- Dog training and socialization
- Pet wellness and veterinary care
- Community outreach programs
- Pet reunification and lost/found services
- Volunteer opportunities
- Animal welfare advocacy
- End-of-life pet services
- Pet rehoming programs
- Adoption requirements and guidelines
- Community Pet Wellness Clinic
- Canine Academy
- Donation and legacy giving

## Adoption Services

- [Dog Adoption](https://www.animalprotective.org/adopt-a-dog): Browse and adopt dogs from Animal Protective Foundation
- [Adopt a Cat](https://www.animalprotective.org/adopt-a-cat): Find and adopt cats available through Animal Protective Foundation
- [Adopt Small Animals](https://www.animalprotective.org/adopt-a-small-animal): Browse rabbits, guinea pigs, and other small pets for adoption
- [Animal Adoption Guide](https://www.animalprotective.org/adoption-requirements): Adoption process, requirements, and guidelines for pet adoption
- [Stray Animals](https://www.animalprotective.org/view-strays-in-our-care): View stray animals in shelter care available for adoption
- [Pet Rehoming](https://www.animalprotective.org/theres-no-place-like-home): Private pet rehoming program for finding new homes

## Veterinary & Wellness Services

- [Spay & Neuter Services](https://www.animalprotective.org/spay-neuter): Affordable spay/neuter services and appointment booking
- [End of Life Pet Services](https://www.animalprotective.org/end-of-life-services): Compassionate euthanasia, cremation, and memorial services

## Pet Training & Community Programs

- [Canine Academy](https://www.animalprotective.org/canine-academy): Canine Academy dog training classes and puppy socialization
- [Pet Training Events & Support Groups](https://www.animalprotective.org/news-events): Pet training classes and events like Woofstock and Fur Ball

## Pet Reunification & Lost & Found

- [Lost & Found Pets](https://www.animalprotective.org/lost---found): Report lost or found pets and reunite with families
- [Lost Animals](https://www.animalprotective.org/view-lost-animals): View and report lost pets in the community
- [Found Pets](https://www.animalprotective.org/view-found-animals): Report and view found animals to reunite with owners

## Get Involved & Support

- [Volunteer Program](https://www.animalprotective.org/apf-volunteer-program): APF Volunteer Program application and opportunities
- [Animal Donations](https://www.animalprotective.org/give): Donation programs including Angel Fund and legacy giving options

## Organization & News

- [Animal Services](https://www.animalprotective.org): Homepage with adoption, veterinary services, and community outreach
- [About Us](https://www.animalprotective.org/about-us): Animal Protective Foundation's mission and organizational overview
- [Animal Services News](https://www.animalprotective.org/news): Latest articles, pet wellness tips, and community clinic updates
- [Contact Animal Services](https://www.animalprotective.org/contact): Contact information, hours, and inquiry form for Animal Protective Foundation
